snippet.title: Website par customer bharosa kyun nahi karta? Social proof #Shorts
snippet.description:
Website par sirf 'hum best quality dete hain' likha hai, aur koi saboot nahi? To customer skip kar deta hai. Naya visitor aapko jaanta nahi, woh daavon par nahi, saboot par bharosa karta hai.

Example: ek CA firm ki website par bas services ki list thi. Client ki permission se teen chhote case studies daale, aur visitors ka bharosa badha.

Website par social proof kaise dikhayein:
1. Asli reviews, naam aur shehar ke saath
2. Kaam ki asli photos, pehle aur baad wali
3. Chhote case studies: problem, kaam, result
4. Proof homepage aur enquiry button ke paas rakhiye

Aapke paas kaun sa proof hai jo website par abhi nahi dikhta? Comment kariye.
